verdicts.reason: A reads left to right: watch, then the headline, price and subcopy, then the CTA. But the watch is cropped against the left edge, the logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck, and the warranty fine print is squeezed into an illegible block under the CTA. B puts the illegible legal paragraph first on the far left, ahead of the product and headline. Its logo is jammed against the subcopy, and the subcopy wraps to leave an orphaned '100 m.', so its hierarchy and reading order are clearly broken.
